name: Title sequence — drop in with impact
description: Hero title moment. Heavy condensed sans title drops in from above the frame with a 12-tap directional motion blur trail that fades as velocity drops to zero, hits a brief brightness flash at the impact frame (progress 0.21), and settles with a faint decaying shake. All motion is shader-driven via UV offset on the captured text texture; the DOM renders the title statically at its resting position. Atmospheric deep-black backdrop with subtle off-frame warm glow (upper-left key) and fine film grain. Tests shader-driven text motion + directional motion blur, a technique not exercised by any existing preset.
